Here's the HTML and JavaScript code shown in the image:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
  <head>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/axios/1.7.6/axios.min.js"></script>
    <script>
      function sendRequest() {
        axios.post("https://localhost:3000/sum", {
          a: document.getElementById("a").value,
          b: document.getElementById("b").value
        });
      }
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <input id="a" type="text" placeholder="First value" />
    <input id="b" type="text" placeholder="Second value" />
    <button onclick="sendRequest()">Find sum</button>
  </body>
</html>
```

Let me know if you want:
- the backend code to handle the `/sum` endpoint,
- to display the result on the page,
- error handling,
- or to switch from `text` to `number` inputs.
